# Florence Le

> > A curated food and travel guide featuring restaurant recommendations and dining experiences across New England and New York City.

Florence Le offers carefully curated dining guides with a focus on coastal New England destinations like Newport, Rhode Island, and New York City's vibrant food scene. The site provides practical alternatives to popular restaurants and highlights both fine dining establishments and casual seafood spots.

## Key Topics

- Newport dining
- Rhode Island restaurants
- New York City Italian food
- Coastal New England cuisine
- Seafood guides
- Via Carota alternatives
- West Village restaurants
- Fine dining recommendations
- Clam shacks
- Travel food guides
- Restaurant recommendations
- Castle Hill Inn
- East Bay dining
- NYC food scene

## Rhode Island & New England Dining

- [The Rhode Island Guide: Where to Eat in Newport](https://florencele.com/food/the-rhode-island-guide-where-to-eat-in-newport): Dining guide for Newport, Rhode Island featuring seafood and New England eats

## New York City Restaurant Guides

- [The NYC Food Guide: Where To Get Delicious Italian Food If You Can't Get Into Via Carota](https://florencele.com/food/new-york-food-guide-where-to-get-delicious-italian-food-if-you-cant-get-into-via-carota): NYC Italian restaurant alternatives to Via Carota in West Village
